gallery.description:
The Vaillancourt Fountain (apparently under renovation at the time), located in Justin Herman Plaza near the foot of Market Street and across the Embarcadero from the Ferry Building.

The controversial and now demolished Embarcadero Freeway can be seen at the top.

gallery.title: File:I-480 from Hyatt Regency ca 1988.jpg
gallery.description: The Embarcadero Freeway (I-480) as seen from the Hyatt Regency, San Francisco, in 1988.  Also shown in this picture are the Vaillancourt Fountains.  Behind the trees is the on-ramp from Clay Street (top deck) and the off-ramp to Washington Street (lower deck).  After the 1989 earthquake damaged this freeway, it was torn down in 1991.
